semantic_meaning: Overlays consequence/failure/exposure as a distinct red layer (never decorative).
when_to_use: When showing failure modes, shutdowns, losses, or exposure
When a consequence is the point of the beat (not a footnote)
When a claim explicitly involves damage/cost/extraction
when_not_to_use: As an accent color for drama

forbidden.red_decorative: Red may not be used as decoration.
forbidden.amber: Amber is reserved for leverage/chokepoint only (separate device).

animation_behavior.description: Red layer appears as a diagnostic overlay (scan/fill), then locks into a single crisp consequence marker.

input_parameters.name: affected_region
input_parameters.description: Region of the diagram/frame affected by the consequence.

state_beats.label: consequence_lock
state_beats.meaningful_change: Overlay locks to a specific marker/region.

state_beats.label: aftermath
state_beats.meaningful_change: Return to structure with consequence still visible (dimmed).

expected_outputs: A clear red consequence layer that does not read as decorative accent
validation_notes: If red is present, the scene must explicitly be about consequence/failure/exposure.
